summary: Nexera Technologies Ltd, an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on a US exchange, filed a Form 6-K furnishing proxy materials for its Annual General Meeting scheduled for 3:00 p.m. Israel time on December 10, 2026, at its Bnei Brak offices. The exhibits comprise a notice and proxy statement dated November 5, 2026, plus a proxy card; the record date is October 27, 2026. The board recommends voting FOR each proposal, whose substance is not detailed in the excerpt. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation; watch the proposal specifics and any extraordinary agenda items.
